issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'וְעַל חֶמְדַּת נָשִׁים' means 'the desire of women' (i.e., the object of women's desire, often understood as a reference to a deity or idol women cherish), not '妻子的寶物' (wife's treasure). The Chinese rendering narrows 'women' to 'wife' and changes 'desire' to 'treasure,' altering the meaning.
